content.title: Illinois Announces 2026 Coaching Staff Update - University of Illinois Athletics
content.text: Skip To Main Content Pause All Rotators Story Links CHAMPAIGN, Ill. — Illinois head coach Bret Bielema announced the following updates to the 2026 staff: Chris Hurd — Special Teams Coordinator Archie McDaniel — Outside Linebackers Coach Mike Neu — Pass Game Coordinator Artur Sitkowski — Quarterbacks Coach Danny Cameron — Senior Offensive Analyst/Assistant Running Backs Coach Harper Cole — Assistant Wide Receivers Coach Houston Griffith — Assistant Tight Ends Coach Alex Panos — Assistant Defensive Line Coach The Fighting Illini begin spring practices on Monday, March 23.
